title: Each API route has one unit test file, route.test.ts
context: Route unit tests were split across route.test.ts, request-schema.test.ts and files named after an action, so the same kind of case lived in different files for different routes.
decision: Each API route whose handler the repository writes has exactly one unit test file, __tests__/route.test.ts beside its route.ts, holding every unit case for that route, request-schema rejections included. Cases moved out of integration tests, the existing request-schema.test.ts files and action-named files are merged into it; a file that never runs its route is deleted, not merged. A route whose handler a library generates whole, such as the Better Auth catch-all, has no unit test: with the library replaced nothing of the route is left to run, and only end-to-end and API smoke tests can prove it.

alternatives.option: A separate request-schema.test.ts for validation cases
alternatives.reason: Which file a case belongs in would be a judgement the one-file rule removes.

consequences: Some route test files grow to a few hundred lines.
A file that asserts only values it built itself is deleted rather than carried into route.test.ts.
